pr_title: Allow rename database export file in settings
pr_comment: There is no need for this anymore, as SAF supports renaming while creating files

review_comment: We could also append ".zip" when the file name does not have that extension.

So, should I don't ask extension of file in file name or if user enter file name without any dots, I append ".zip" at the end of it?

What should I do if user enter "foo.rar" ? make it "foo.zip"? or "foo.rar.zip"?
